title: Classical Hardness of Learning Functions of Hamiltonians
abstract: arXiv:2610.01141v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Morohoshi, Nakayama, Manabe, and Mitarai proposed a physically motivated quantum machine learning problem in which the goal is to predict quantities of the form $\operatorname{Tr}[f(H)\rho]$ from classical descriptions of a Hamiltonian $H$ and a quantum state $\rho$, where $f$ is an unknown function. We call this problem Hamiltonian function learning in this paper. They constructed an efficient quantum learning algorithm under suitable conditions, while leaving a rigorous proof of average-case classical hardness open. In this paper, we rigorously prove the average-case classical hardness for two distribution-specific Hamiltonian function learning problems for $f_{\cos,\pi}(\lambda)=\cos(\pi\lambda)$ and $f_{\exp,\beta}(\lambda)=e^{-\beta\lambda}$ discussed in the paper of Morohoshi et al. under the assumption of the average-case hardness of factoring random RSA moduli. translated_title: 哈密顿量函数学习的经典困难性
translated_abstract: Morohoshi、Nakayama、Manabe 和 Mitarai 提出了一个具有物理动机的量子机器学习问题，其目标是从哈密顿量 H 和量子态 ρ 的经典描述出发，预测形如 Tr[f(H)ρ] 的量，其中 f 是一个未知函数。本文将此问题称为哈密顿量函数学习。他们在适当条件下构造了高效的量子学习算法，但该问题平均情形下经典困难性的严格证明仍是悬而未决的开放问题。在本文中，我们在“对随机 RSA 模数进行因子分解的平均情形困难性”这一假设下，严格证明了 Morohoshi 等人论文中讨论的两个针对特定分布的哈密顿量函数学习问题（即 f_{cos,π}(λ)=cos(πλ) 和 f_{exp,β}(λ)=e^{-βλ}）的平均情形经典困难性。更具体地说，我们证明了高效的经典随机学习器……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文在随机 RSA 模数因子分解平均情形困难性的假设下，首次严格证明了两类哈密顿量函数学习问题（对应 f(λ)=cos(πλ) 与 f(λ)=e^{-βλ}）的平均情形经典困难性。
en_tdlr: Under the assumption of the average-case hardness of factoring random RSA moduli, this paper rigorously proves the average-case classical hardness of two distribution-specific Hamiltonian function learning problems for f(λ)=cos(πλ) and f(λ)=e^{-βλ}.
